llms.body:
# therefor.us

> Keep talking with someone you've lost, in their own voice. Families upload recordings, letters, messages, and photos to build a voice from repaired audio and a private persona memory.

## Core Facts
- Website: https://therefor.us
- What it is: A recording of how someone spoke, cleaned from everyday audio (voicemails, WhatsApp voice notes, old videos) and paired with their words and shared memories. It is not the person.
- Similarity Check: Every voice receives a measured match score shown before anyone pays.
- Ownership: One-time Voice Preservation ($39.00) includes a downloadable voice file families keep offline.
- Privacy: Nothing is shared, sold, or used to train external models.
- Billing: Free text tier ($0, 1 person, 40 messages, no voice). Prepaid voice/remembrance windows ($9.99/30d, $89/yr, Family $19.99/30d, 20-year Legacy Vault $349) paid in USDT, USDC, or DAI on Ethereum; zero auto-renewal.

## Key Public URLs
- Home: https://therefor.us/
- Pricing: https://therefor.us/pricing
- Journal: https://therefor.us/blog
- Preservation Guides: https://therefor.us/guides
- Comparisons: https://therefor.us/compare
- Sitemap: https://therefor.us/sitemap.xml

  2. 2
